description: Verifiable dice roll from a seed, with a re-derivable transcript — Rolls dice notation (for example 4d6kh3+2) from a caller seed with a documented SHA-256 counter-mode stream and returns every die, the kept/dropped marks and a full draw transcript, for agents and referees that need a roll anyone can re-derive. Optionally checks a claimed total or claimed faces against the re-derived roll. Does NOT provide unpredictable randomness: the seed is public input, so any

expectRolls.description: Optional claimed faces in notation order, before keep/drop marks.

includeTranscript.description: Default true. False drops blocks and draws (the transcript digest stays).

notation.description: Dice notation: terms of NdM (N 1-100, M 2-1000) or integers joined by + and -; optional kh/kl/dh/dl with a count on a group. At most 20 groups and 1000 dice.

seed.description: Caller seed string. Public: the outcome is a pure function of notation and seed.

name: dice-roll
